# Spatial Omic Structure Analysis

![](inst/extdata/sosta.png)

`sosta` (spatial omics structure analysis) is a framework to
reconstruct, characterize and compare spatial structures from spatial
omics data.

`sosta` builds on existing R packages for spatial analysis such as
`spatstat`, `sf` and the [Bioconductor](https://bioconductor.org/)
environment by integrating with packages `SpatialExperiment` and
`SpatialFeatureExperiment`, which facilitates the implementation of
additional custom metrics that fit the needs of users.

## Installation

Installation of the latest [Bioconductor
version](https://bioconductor.org/packages/sosta) can be done as
follows:

``` r
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager")) {
    install.packages("BiocManager")
}
BiocManager::install("sosta")
```

You can install the development version of `sosta` from GitHub with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("sgunz/sosta")
```

## Feedback

We are happy to get your feedback. Please send it via email to [Samuel
Gunz](https://www.mls.uzh.ch/en/research/robinson/groupmembers/samuel-gunz.html)
or open a issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/sgunz/sosta/issues).

## Citation

If you use `sosta` please consider citing:

> Gunz, Samuel, Helena Lucia Crowell, and Mark D. Robinson. “Analysis of
> Anatomical Multi-Cellular Structures from Spatial Omics Data Using
> Sosta”, p. 2025.10.13.682065. bioRxiv, 14 Oct. 2025,
> <https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.10.13.682065>.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`SPE2ppp()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/SPE2ppp.md) :

  Function to convert spatial coordinates of a `SpatialExperiment`
  object to a `ppp` object

- [`assingCellsToStructures()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/assingCellsToStructures.md)
  : Function to assign points / coordinates to structures

- [`binaryImageToSF()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/binaryImageToSF.md)
  : Converts a binary matrix to an sf polygon

- [`cellTypeProportions()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/cellTypeProportions.md)
  : Calculate the proportion of each cell type within spatial structures

- [`createPointPatternTissue()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/createPointPatternTissue.md)
  : Create a Point Pattern on a Simulated Tissue Image

- [`.SPE2df()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/dot-SPE2df.md) :

  Function to convert `SpatialExperiment` object to a data frame

- [`.df2ppp()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/dot-df2ppp.md) :

  Function to convert `data.frame` to `ppp` object

- [`.intensityImage()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/dot-intensityImage.md)
  : Function to estimate the intensity image of a point pattern

- [`.intensityThreshold()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/dot-intensityThreshold.md)
  : Function to estimate the intensity threshold for the reconstruction
  of spatial structures

- [`estimateReconstructionParametersSPE()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/estimateReconstructionParametersSPE.md)
  : Estimate reconstruction parameters from a set of images

- [`findIntensityThreshold()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/findIntensityThreshold.md)
  : Estimate the intensity threshold for the reconstruction of spatial
  structures

- [`getDimXY()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/getDimXY.md) :
  Function to get the dimension based on dim of y axis

- [`meanShapeMetrics()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/meanShapeMetrics.md)
  : Calculate mean shape metrics of a set of polygons

- [`minBoundaryDistances()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/minBoundaryDistances.md)
  : Compute minimum boundary distances for each cell within its
  corresponding image structures

- [`minCellTypeStructDist()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/minCellTypeStructDist.md)
  : Compute minimum distances from each cell types to structure
  boundaries per structure

- [`normalizeCoordinates()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/normalizeCoordinates.md)
  : Function to normalize coordinates between zero and one while keep
  scaling

- [`reconstructShapeDensity()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/reconstructShapeDensity.md)
  : Reconstruct polygon from point pattern density

- [`reconstructShapeDensityImage()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/reconstructShapeDensityImage.md)
  : Reconstruct structure from spe object with given image id

- [`reconstructShapeDensitySPE()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/reconstructShapeDensitySPE.md)
  : Reconstruct structure from spatial experiment object per image id

- [`shapeIntensityImage()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/shapeIntensityImage.md)
  : Intensity plot

- [`shapeMetrics()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/shapeMetrics.md)
  : Calculate a set of shape metrics of a polygon

- [`simulateTissueBlobs()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/simulateTissueBlobs.md)
  : Simulate Tissue Blobs

- [`sostaSPE`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/sostaSPE.md) :
  Example SpatialExperiment Object with Simulated Tissue Images and
  Point Patterns

- [`spatialCoords2SF()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/spatialCoords2SF.md)
  : Function to convert spatialCoords to an sf object

- [`stCalculateCurvature()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/stCalculateCurvature.md)
  : Calculate curvature of sf object

- [`stCalculateShapeCurl()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/stCalculateShapeCurl.md)
  : Calculate curl of a polygon

- [`stFeatureAxes()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/stFeatureAxes.md)
  : Calculate the length of feature axes of an sf polygon

- [`totalShapeMetrics()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/totalShapeMetrics.md)
  : Calculate a set of shape metrics of a set of polygons

- [`xyCoordinates()`](https://sgunz.github.io/sosta/reference/xyCoordinates.md)
  : Function to extract x y coordinates from binary image
